blocks.text: Japan’s genre-blurring luv brings their blend of neo-soul, jazz, and R&B with their debut album wabi-sabi, featuring a collaboration with Australian artist BOY SODA Japan’s rising soul-groove phenomenon luv will introduce themselves to a wider global audience with their debut full-length album, wabi-sabi, arriving November 4 via Warner Music Japan. Hailing from Osaka, the five-piece are rapidly establishing themselves as one of Japan’s most exciting musical exports, bringing together neo-soul, the infectious rhythms of R&B, the improvisational spirit of jazz and the energy of hip-hop.
